segments.comment: Wizard-mode level teleport (^V) to level 0 answered y. teleport.c level_tele() prints "You scream in agony..." and calls display_nhwindow(WIN_MESSAGE, FALSE) (teleport.c:1261), whose --More-- is answered with Escape. wintty.c more() then sets WIN_STOP, so update_topl() suppresses "You cease to exist." and the possessions message until the "Die?" prompt. Declining death reaches the rematerialization messages. Seed, clock, character and keys were chosen for this path.
